chunks: And by this chain, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Ali ibn al-Husayn (may Allah's blessings be upon him) used to say: 'Indeed We revealed it on the Night of Power'

God Almighty and Majestic spoke the truth. God revealed the Quran on the Night of Power. 'And what will make you know what the Night of Power is?' — the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'I do not know.' God Almighty and Majestic said: 'The Night of Power is better than a thousand months' in which there is no Night of Power. He asked the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family): 'Do you know why it is better than a thousand months?' He said: 'No.' He said: 'Because therein the angels and the Spirit descend by the permission of their Lord for every affair', and when God Almighty and Majestic permits something, He has approved it. 'Peace it is until the break of dawn' — He is saying: 'My angels and My Spirit submit their greetings upon you, O Muhammad, with My greeting, from the beginning of their descent until the break of dawn.'

Then He said in another part of His Book: 'And guard yourselves against a trial which may not afflict particularly those of you who are unjust' (8:25) — regarding 'Indeed We revealed it on the Night of Power' (97:1). And He said in another part of His Book: 'And Muhammad is no more than a messenger; indeed messengers have passed away before him; if then he dies or is killed, will you turn back upon your heels? And whoever turns back upon his heels, he shall not do harm to God in the least, and God will reward the grateful' (3:144).

He is saying in the first verse: when Muhammad passes away, the people of opposition to God's command Almighty and Majestic will say: 'The Night of Power expired with the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family).' So this is a trial that afflicted them specifically, and by it they turned back upon their heels — because if they were to say 'It did not pass away,' then there would inevitably have to be a command from God Almighty and Majestic during it, and if they acknowledged the command, there could be no escape from there being a Master for it.

key_terms.أَمْر: Command/affair — God's divine command or decree, particularly regarding the governance of creation
key_terms.أَهْلُ الْخِلَافِ: People of opposition — those who opposed the divinely-appointed Imam after the Prophet's death
key_terms.صَاحِب: Master/possessor — here referring to the Imam who holds authority during Laylat al-Qadr
key_terms.فِتْنَة: Trial/tribulation — the spiritual and political strife of denying the Imam's authority
key_terms.لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ: Laylat al-Qadr — the Night of Power/Destiny, the blessed night of the first revelation of the Quran

ai.seo_question: Why does Imam Zayn al-Abidin say Laylat al-Qadr proves the necessity of the Imam?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) quotes Imam Zayn al-Abidin (AS) who explains the exegesis of Surah al-Qadr (97), presenting a theological argument for the continuation of Laylat al-Qadr after the Prophet's death as proof of the necessity of the Imamate. The argument is that those who opposed the Imam were caught in a logical dilemma: if they admitted that Laylat al-Qadr continues, they would have to acknowledge that God's commands must descend to someone with authority — i.e., an Imam — and if they denied its continuation, they would contradict the Quran. The hadith connects Quranic verses from Surah al-Qadr (97), Surah al-Anfal (8:25), and Surah Al Imran (3:144) to establish that the Imamate is a theological necessity grounded in the ongoing nature of divine revelation and governance.

en.hubeali: (It has been narrated) ‘from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Aliasws Bin Al-Husaynasws was saying [97:1] We have indeed revealed this in the Night of Pre-determination.

Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Spoke the Truth. Allahazwj Revealed the Quran during the Night of the Pre-determination (Laylat Al-Qadr) [97:3] The Night of Pre-determination is better than a thousand months wherein there is no Night of Pre-determination. Heazwj asked Rasool-Allahsaww: “Do yousaww know why it is better than a thousand months?” Hesaww said: ‘Because [97:4] Therein come down the angels and the Spirit by Allah's Permission from every affair; and when Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Permits for something, so it has Pleased Himazwj [97:5] Peace! Such it is till the break of the morning. Heazwj is Saying: “They are submitting upon yousaww, O Muhammadsaww, Myazwj Angels and Myazwj Spirit with Myazwj Greetings, from the beginning of what they are descending up to the emergence of the dawn’.

Then Heazwj Said in (another) part of Hisazwj Book [8:25] And fear a strife which may not smite (only) those of you in particular who are unjust, in particular regarding [97:1] We have indeed revealed this in the Night of Predestination. And Heazwj Said in (another) part of Hisazwj Book [3:144] And what is Muhammad except for a Rasool; the Rasools have already passed away before him; if then he dies or is killed will you turn back upon your heels? And whoever turns back upon his heels, he will by no means do harm to Allah in the least and Allah will Reward the grateful.

Heazwj is Saying in the first Verse that Muhammadsaww, when hesaww passes away, the people of the opposition to the Command of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic would be saying, ‘The Night of Pre-determination (Laylat Al-Qadr) expired along with Rasool-Allahsaww’. So this is a strife hitting them in particular, and by it they are turning back upon their heels because they, if they were to say, ‘It (Laylat Al-Qadr) did not go away, so it would be inevitable that there would happen to be for Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic a Command during it, and when they acknowledge with the Command, there cannot happen to be an escape from there being a Masterasws for it’.
en.sarwar: 3. Through the same chain of narrators it is narrated from abu Ja‘far (a.s.) who has said the following.
“Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High, has said about the Night of Determination, “. . every absolute command coming from Us becomes distinguishable.” [44:4]

He has said that absolute and strong command. Absolute and strong command is not two things. It is only one thing. One who judges without disharmony and differences his judgment is of the judgment of Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High. Whoever would judge in disharmonious manner with differences and considers it as the rightful way of judging he has judged with the judgment of the devil. It is certain that on the Night of Determination the explanation and clarification of all issues of the year comes to the man who possesses Divine authority. On that Night the Wali al-’Amr (the man who possesses Divine authority) receives commands about his self for so and so, and about the affairs of the people in so and so. It also is certain that for the man with Divine authority, besides this, every year, there comes the knowledge of Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High. (There comes to him) the exclusive knowledge, the hidden, the wonderful and the treasured knowledge of Allah. It comes just in the Night of Determination comes the command.

Then he recited. “If all the trees in the earth were pens and the ocean, with seven more oceans, were ink still these could not suffice to record all the Words of God. God is Majestic and All-wise.” [31:27].
